violations.text: Menu lacks allergen statement. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026
Per interview with PIC, no one has the RI certified food safety manager license. PIC does have active ServSafe. FMC application provided. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026
The hand-washing sink located at the bar is lacking hand-washing signage. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026

Soap was not available at the hand-washing sinks in the kitchen, bar, and basement restroom. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. PIC obtained hand soap for sinks during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026
The hand-washing sinks in the kitchen, bar, and basement restroom was lacking paper towels. PIC obtained during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026
Food and straws were observed in hand-washing sink at the bar. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026

Raw animal foods (such as eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as cooked foods) in the 1 door refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. PIC relocated eggs. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (food chopper blades) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC washed/sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026

Burgers and steak are served raw or undercooked to the customer's request. A written consumer advisory (on the menu, table tent, or placard) is not provided to the consumer informing them of the significantly increased risk associated with certain vulnerable consumers eating such food in a raw or undercooked form. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026
Working containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026

Chlorine sanitizer solution was observed in excess of 200 parts per million (ppm). A chlorine sanitizer solution applied to food contact surfaces must be between 50-100 ppm. PIC emptied 3 bay sink, refilled, and retested. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026

The establishment is lacking a thermometer to test food temperatures. Food temperature measuring devices shall be provided and be readily accessible for checking cooking, cooling, reheating, and hot/cold holding temperatures of time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026

The door to the outside, located in the front, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 09/28/2026
Utensils were observed stored in stagnant water between uses. PIC emptied and washed/sanitized utensils. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quat AND chlorine sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the microwave and table under grills have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026
Inspector observed a heavy accumulation of trash and debris behind and around refuse area. Area to be maintained clean. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026

The floors in the basement storage closet have an accumulation of soil residue, small rodent droppings, and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026
